title: Tokusatsu Gagaga
synopsis: Nakamura Kano is an OL (office lady) with a secret… she’s a “Toku Otaku,” a tokusatsu otaku who is obsessed with live action dramas of heroes, monsters and robots. She thinks they’re “JUST TOO COOL!” She’s so obsessed that she skips out on drinking with colleagues to watch it on TV and collects the DVDs, books and figurines. She lives her life by the code of the tokusatsu heroes, and constantly imagines them to help her through difficult situations. But this isn’t easy when all of her co-workers think that people who like anime and other childish things are weird, and they keep trying to make her socialize. Notes: Nominated to the 21st Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

title: Never Mind, Darling
synopsis: After an intense night of drinking, Dawoon has a dream about the kiss he and Jin shared back in high school, something he had long forgotten. He feels uneasy but ignores it, blaming the dream on his long hiatus from dating—until he runs into Jin on campus the next day. Jin seems unusually playful and clingy, poking and prodding at feelings buried in Dawoon’s heart. When Dawoon confronts him about it, a casual reply—”We just kissed”—only adds fuel to the fire. As their long-standing friendship begins to blur into something more, Dawoon must confront his own complex feelings while Jin comes face to face with his heart’s desires. (Source: Lezhin US)

synopsis: Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.

title: Smile!
synopsis: A journalist risks everything to uncover the truth behind a sinister cult... Yuushi Kamome is a freelance journalist who lost his beloved daughter in an unforeseen accident. His descent into despair following her death drove his wife to leave him, and he lives each day a shell of the man he once was. But his fate changes one day when members from a religious organization he had never heard of, the Smiling Hearts Society, knock on his door and hand him a flyer. He’s ready to dismiss them until he notices the face of his estranged wife on the flyer, smiling ever so softly. And so begins a tale of religion and insanity. What kind of sinister darkness lurks behind this religion and its strange smiles? (Source: Kodama)
